instructions: Attempt any three questions out of the remaining five.
Assume suitable data, if required and state it clearly.

questions.label: 1a
questions.text: Discuss the role of gradient descent in neural network learning.

questions.label: 1b
questions.text: Discuss the working of Feed Forward and Recurrent Neural Networks.

questions.label: 1c
questions.text: Explain the major factors influencing the learning efficiency of a deep neural network.

questions.label: 1d
questions.text: Describe the importance of activation functions in deep learning models.

questions.label: 1e
questions.text: Explain how MSE measures prediction error in regression models.

questions.label: 2a
questions.text: Explain the architecture and working of a Feed Forward Neural Network with a neat diagram. Discuss the functions of input, hidden, and output layers.

questions.label: 2b
questions.text: Explain the need for regularization in deep neural networks. Discuss various regularization techniques used to reduce overfitting.

questions.label: 3a
questions.text: Identify the problem when a deep learning model achieves high training accuracy but low validation accuracy. Suggest suitable solutions.

questions.label: 3b
questions.text: Compare the performance of LSTM and GRU on long-sequence datasets. Which one would you choose for faster training and why?

questions.label: 4a
questions.text: Explain the complete workflow of a Convolutional Neural Network with a neat diagram and suitable example.

questions.label: 4b
questions.text: Describe the architecture and training mechanism of RNN using BPTT in detail.

questions.label: 5a
questions.text: Explain the architecture of AlexNet with a diagram. Explain the significance of ReLU activation and Dropout regularization in AlexNet.

questions.label: 5b
questions.text: Compare CNN, RNN, and DNN architectures in terms of data types handled, structure, and applications.

questions.label: 6a
questions.text: Explain the architecture and working principle of a Generative Adversarial Network with a labelled diagram.

questions.label: 6b
questions.text: Analyze the applications of GANs in image generation and image-to-image translation for improving training efficiency.
